review_rules: Review every root and transitive flake.lock input and every configured custom source pin daily. Re-read actual source; inventory dates are not installed version evidence.

Every hold needs concrete reason, upstream evidence URL, affected versions, next review date and a candidate/check or bounded investigation. Missing package-specific runtime coverage is explicit; it is not a blanket ban on batch source updates.

Configured-channel batches support reviewed updates and compatibility repairs in existing allowed tracked Nix files. Protected updater/auth/SSH definitions, file additions/deletions/modes and stateVersion edits remain excluded.

Every batch needs four client host evaluations, full flake checking and full laptop build. Changed T3/Codex-ACP/ChatGPT outputs require their real critical probes; other app runtime behavior is unverified unless actually checked.
All 70 locked nodes observed at seed date remain discoverable dynamically from current flake.lock; all 37 seeded entries remain reviewed and new inputs/pins join the private schema-version-1 review.

Initial clean baseline2ad5d18 reproduced active generation223. Full flake check passed during setup; do not reuse the historical ew-cloud Fontconfig blocker without reproducing it. Current HEAD, declared pins and active versions must be freshly read.

The typed NixOS 25.11 to 26.05 migration updates the matching Home Manager release in the same reviewed batch, preserves stateVersion and needs explicit compatibility evidence. Runtime or migration failures are repaired and rechecked before activation.

batch_policy.review_inventory: All actual root and transitive lock nodes and configured custom pins; the 37 seeded entries and 70 observed locked nodes are starting inventory, not a limit.
batch_policy.configured_channels: Refresh each existing input within its declared owner, repository and channel. Exact revision pins need a documented reason and reviewed replacement. Release-family changes require the typed paired migration.
batch_policy.source_repairs: Reviewed repairs may change existing tracked Nix files within the declared directories. New files, deleted files and file-mode changes are rejected by automatic submission.
protected_sources: Updater implementation, module and command rules
Metadata registry; daily findings remain private review receipts
required_checks: Evaluate nixy-laptop, nixy-desktop, michapc and michapc-debug with --no-write-lock-file
Complete full flake check without lock mutation
Build the full candidate nixy-laptop system
Run independently verified T3, Codex/ACP and ChatGPT probes whenever their relevant outputs change
Preserve source/index originals and obtain a read-only Home snapshot before exact candidate activation

critical_probes.t3: Owned renderer/backend and distinct synthetic database migration; no user-profile copy or scheduled/model execution
critical_probes.codex: CLI version, app-server initialize and candidate-bound ACP initialize; no paid model request
critical_probes.chatgpt: Owned hydrated renderer, native watcher event and required audio-library packaging

batch_policy.runtime_limits: Full host evaluation, flake checking and a laptop build do not prove every application, hardware path or state migration works. Apps outside the three critical probes have build coverage only unless an actual package-specific check is recorded. Unresolved relevant failures require a concrete repair and rerun, or an explicit evidence-backed hold.
batch_policy.host_activation_scope: Only nixy-laptop is automatically activated. Other host evaluations and full-flake checks do not deploy or runtime-test remote servers or other desktops.
batch_policy.release_migration: NixOS 25.11 to 26.05 and matching Home Manager are one typed reviewed pair. Preserve stateVersion; review kernel/EVDI/NVIDIA/initrd/network and mutable /var compatibility explicitly.
batch_policy.evidence_scope: Registry gate descriptions are requirements and coverage declarations. Only fresh candidate receipts prove a test; historical receipts do not establish a later batch or an activation.
